summary: Both assertions follow from the supplied proof. The largest-atom-star comparison, same-band transfer, midpoint-mass recurrence, selected-band energy and variance estimates, and both binning arguments are valid. In particular, the heterogeneous threshold implies m >= 4h + 4 and makes the total discarded deficit uniformly less than 3600. The reflection argument converts the selected rows to actual closed-halfspace depth under the unchanged original product law, with the stated second- and third-moment constants. The predecessor quantities retain their stated normalizations, and empty lists, equal weights, singleton supports, cutoff equalities, and lower-dimensional supports are covered.
